title: LinkedIn Jobs & US Hiring Monitor Input
description: Collect public jobs by keywords, search URLs or individual URLs. Start with one US job using direct HTTP without a proxy. Optional saved watchlists report observed field changes, not closures. LinkedIn may ignore forwarded search filters.

searchUrls.title: LinkedIn Jobs Search URLs
searchUrls.description: Optional full linkedin.com/jobs/search URLs. Search parameters are forwarded and pagination is bounded; LinkedIn may ignore filters. Requested workplace arrangements are checked against public role evidence.

jobUrls.title: Individual LinkedIn Job URLs
jobUrls.description: Optional public linkedin.com/jobs/view URLs for direct job-detail extraction.

keywords.title: Job Keywords
keywords.description: Job titles, skills, or search terms. Use together with locations.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: City, region, or country. Use together with keywords.

workplaceType.title: Workplace Type
workplaceType.description: Require explicit workplace evidence from the public job detail. Nonmatching, unknown and conflicting arrangements are not saved or charged. LinkedIn guest search can ignore this filter; the bounded candidate scan can return fewer than maxResults. Leave empty for an unfiltered scrape.

jobType.title: Job Type
jobType.description: Forward employment-type filters to LinkedIn. Source honoring is not independently verified.

experienceLevel.title: Experience Level
experienceLevel.description: Forward seniority filters to LinkedIn. Source honoring is not independently verified.

datePosted.title: Date Posted
datePosted.description: Filter jobs by how recently LinkedIn posted them.

easyApplyOnly.title: Easy Apply Only
easyApplyOnly.description: Request LinkedIn's Easy Apply search filter. Source honoring is not independently verified; inspect each result.

sortBy.title: Sort Results
sortBy.description: Sort keyword searches by relevance or newest first.

minimumSalary.title: Minimum Salary
minimumSalary.description: Optional LinkedIn salary threshold. Availability and currency depend on the selected market.

maxResults.title: Max Results (total)
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to scrape across all searches

maxJobsPerSearch.title: Max Jobs Per Search
maxJobsPerSearch.description: Maximum jobs to scrape per keyword + location combination

watchlistName.title: Saved job watchlist (optional)
watchlistName.description: Leave empty for a normal scrape. Use the same 1-64 character name on Apify platform runs to compare saved job observations. Case-insensitive letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. Keep search inputs and result limits unchanged; use a new name for a different scope. Reports do not infer job closure or skip normal per-job charges.

watchlistRetentionDays.title: Watchlist retention days
watchlistRetentionDays.description: Retain the last known fields for jobs seen within this many days. Pruning occurs on successful watchlist commits, not automatically while idle. Ignored without watchlistName.

watchlistMaxJobs.title: Maximum retained watchlist jobs
watchlistMaxJobs.description: Bound saved watchlist state, keeping the most recently observed jobs first. Jobs evicted from state may be reported as newly observed if seen again. Ignored without watchlistName.

transport.title: Public source transport
transport.description: Direct HTTP: browser-free, no proxy, at most 180 seconds of source work; stops on blocked responses. Browser: explicitly selected legacy mode requiring at least 1024 MB; proxy costs can exceed small-run revenue. No automatic paid fallback. An API input with an explicit proxy and no transport retains browser behavior.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Used only in browser mode. Leave disabled for direct HTTP. Enable only when you intentionally accept proxy costs; access is not guaranteed.
